svg.aria-label: From a ServiceMonitor to a page: 1. Discover: Every ServiceMonitor, PodMonitor and Probe in every namespace is selected, with no release label needed. The chart adds kubelet, the API server and node-exporter. 2. Scrape: Prometheus pulls each target once a minute into a TSDB on a 55 GiB volume. High-cardinality series are dropped at scrape time. 3. Evaluate: Rules under alerts/ and the chart's rules are evaluated every 30 seconds, the operator default. Three chart rules are replaced by recency-bound copies that keep their names. 4. Alert: Firing alerts are sent to Alertmanager on port 9093 over the v2 API. Severity decides what pages, so critical is priority 2. 5. Serve: Grafana and kromgo query Prometheus in-cluster. The web UI is on envoy-internal, behind the internal route only.
